title: NO KIT ANSWERS ON THE LET THEM GO CARD
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op, when a teammate did not answer the kit question before the party went up, the ascent closed the card but left RANDOM FROM STASH and TOP GEAR on it, still armed. After the raid, Hire nobody at HIRE showed them on the Let them go card, and pressing either one shut the card without letting the hire go, replaced his packed backpack with a random or top gear pick, swapped the guns in his hands and sent the host a stray kit answer. The Let them go card now takes them off before it opens.
now: The Let them go card at HIRE no longer shows RANDOM FROM STASH and TOP GEAR left over from a party ascent.
